title: InformationSystemComponentRelationshipRecord
description: JSON Schema for a cross-catalogue relationship record in the Information System Component catalogue. CR-IS-CAT-02D (2026-10-18). Mirrors the ISF relationship schema from CR-IS-CAT-01D.

id.description: Stable relationship identifier in the isc-rel-NNN namespace.

source_id.description: Canonical entity identifier for the source. May be in this catalog (ISC) or another catalog (ISF, ISS, IF, DataEntity, Metric, etc.).

relationship.description: The relationship kind. Anchored in a metamodel relationship (CR-017..021) or an OpenDEAM allocation declaration (CR-AR-FMWK-04). The `measured_by` kind is an OpenDEAM allocation declaration, NOT a metamodel relationship claim (per G-11).

target_id.description: Canonical entity identifier for the target. May be in this catalog (ISC) or another catalog (ISF, ISS, IF, DataEntity, Metric, etc.).

cardinality.description: The cardinality of the relationship from the source's perspective.

cr.description: The CR that introduced this relationship record.
